# Markwicks Services

> Family-owned landscaping and grounds maintenance business based in Kelso, serving
> Bathurst and the Central West of New South Wales, Australia. Trading since around
> 2011; renamed from Markwick's Mowing on 25 June 2020. Runs its own earthmoving
> plant rather than hiring it in, which is why maintenance contracts, landscaping and
> excavation are handled by one operator.

## Services

- [Landscaping](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/landscaping): Garden beds, decorative gravel, edging, retaining walls, turf and site preparation. Groundwork and planting handled by the same crew.
- [Commercial grounds maintenance](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/commercial-grounds-maintenance): Standing contracts on a fixed recurring schedule for schools, education campuses, aged care, strata complexes and industrial sites.
- [Residential services](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/residential-services): Mowing rounds, garden maintenance, hedge trimming and property upkeep, with frequency following the growing season.
- [Rural and acreage services](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/rural-acreage-services): Acreage mowing, paddock slashing, property clearing and fire hazard reduction ahead of the fire season.
- [Weed management](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/weed-management): Herbicide application and priority weed control under the NSW Biosecurity Act 2015.
- [Earthworks and excavation](https://markwicksservices.com.au/services/earthworks-excavation): Levelling, site preparation, trenching and drainage using Bobcat skid steers and excavators.

## Areas served

- [Areas we serve](https://markwicksservices.com.au/areas): Coverage across Bathurst, Kelso and the wider Central West.
- [Orange](https://markwicksservices.com.au/areas/orange): ~900mm annual rainfall against Bathurst's ~705mm, elevation 600-1,390m, basalt-derived soils near Mount Canobolas. Weed biosecurity administered by Orange City Council rather than the Central Tablelands Weeds Authority.
- [Lithgow](https://markwicksservices.com.au/areas/lithgow): ~950m elevation, ~860mm rainfall, sandstone country on the western edge of the Blue Mountains. Covers Portland and Wallerawang.
- [Oberon](https://markwicksservices.com.au/areas/oberon): 1,113m, the coldest town in New South Wales. Snow most winters and frosts across autumn, winter and spring, giving the shortest growing season in the region.
- [Blayney](https://markwicksservices.com.au/areas/blayney): 863m in the Belubula Valley. Cold air pools off surrounding hills, producing a frost period of five to eight months and a recorded minimum of -10.6C.

## Background

- [About](https://markwicksservices.com.au/about): Family history, the 2020 rename, and how the business operates.
- [Equipment](https://markwicksservices.com.au/equipment): Bobcat S770 and S650 skid steers in tracked and wheeled configurations, Bobcat E50 and E20 excavators, commercial mowers, compact tractor, spraying buggy and truck fleet.
- [Portfolio](https://markwicksservices.com.au/portfolio): Completed jobs across commercial grounds contracts, rural excavation and residential landscaping.
- [Contact](https://markwicksservices.com.au/contact): Quotes follow a site visit; access, slope and ground conditions affect price more than area does.
